title: Carport width as a proportion of frontage
text: Carports and supporting structure shall not exceed 60 per cent of the frontage where projected forward of the primary street setback line in accordance with C3.3.4.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.6.4. Applies only where the carport projects forward of the primary street setback line (C3.3.4); that trigger is not encoded, the rule runs for any carport.

verified.note: 60% value and wording confirmed. The trigger 'where projected forward of the primary street setback line in accordance with C3.3.4' has no fact; the rule runs for any carport, so it can report DOES_NOT_MEET for a carport behind the setback line. Left as encoded (pairing signature).
